consent: volunteer consented to analysis and public use
note: A live run through the real HTTP API on a real face: a volunteer, with consent. Calibrated from 6 same-evening photos (auto-cropped to the face), then two selfies taken 10 seconds apart in the same room and light, the 'before and after in the mirror' scenario. The skin did not change, so the honest answer is that nothing is proven. Both check-in photos were auto-cropped to the face before YouCam (cropped bytes were analysed; an earlier analysis of the uncropped originals is shown for comparison).
